messages:
Priya: starting change window for eu-prod canary rollout 3.2.1 -> 3.3.0. preflight checks green, will push 5% traffic to canary. infra oncall FYI :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary v3.3.0 -> eu-prod (traffic=5%). preflight: OK. link: https://console.redwood/svc/canary/3.3.0

Sam: seeing p95 jump on embeddings route, dashboard -> https://telemetry.redwood/dashboards/embeds-slo (p95 ~980ms, baseline ~420ms). error rate slight uptick (0.9% -> 1.8%). tagging SRE.

alex: can we freeze traffic at 5% and pin routing if this continues for 5m? command to pin: `redwood route pin --region eu-prod --route embeds --version v3.2.1`

Priya: copying smoke query on the failing requests, looks like 500s from embed-service backpressure. snippet of recent logs:
```
[2026-03-21T10:12:03Z] embed-service request id=abcd1234 status=500 reason=kv_cache_miss:queue_timeout
[2026-03-21T10:12:07Z] embed-service request id=abcd1239 status=500 reason=backend_conn_reset
```

SRE-bot: ALERT SUMMARY: embeds route error_rate=3.2% (15m), p95=1.02s (5m). Threshold breach: error_rate>1.0% and p95>0.8s. Auto-pause candidate: yes. See runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/deploys/embeds-slo-checks :rotating_light:

Maria: +1 to hold at 5% and enable fallback routing to the smaller variant (v3.3.0-small) for latency-sensitive customers. That buys us time to triage without full rollback.

Priya: decision rubric: if p95 > 800ms AND error_rate > 1.5% for 5 continuous minutes -> pin route to v3.2.1 and notify release notes owner. Sam, can you watch 5m window and call pin if persists?

Sam: watching now. will call pin if condition holds. adding a quick smoke: `curl -H "x-test:canary" https://eu-prod.embeds/api/v1/encode` -> response times 1.1s right now.

alex: prepping the rollback command just in case: `redwood rollout rollback --service embeds --to-version v3.2.1 --reason "p95+errors during canary"`

SRE-bot: autopause trigger evaluated: condition met at 10:17:02Z (p95 window 5m, error_rate 3.2%). Candidate action: PAUSE TRAFFIC. Awaiting manual pin/rollback.

Priya: ok executing manual pin now to minimize customer impact. alex please stand by to roll forward if we stabilize.

deploy-bot: route pinned: embeds @ eu-prod -> v3.2.1 by Priya at 6182034827. canary traffic rolled back. Incident tag: #canary-eu-6182034567.

Sam: confirmed traffic back to stable, p95 dropping toward baseline (~430ms). I'll update the release notes and add the root cause blurb (KV cache GC cadence caused transient backpressure).

Priya: thanks team — I'll open a follow-up postmortem and schedule a short tweak to the kvcache GC config in the next sprint. closing change window early. :white_check_mark:
